tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdzong sar 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po'i bka' babs kyi smin grol dkyus gcig tu 'bog pa'i bca' bsham bya tshul mthong bas don rtogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

/'pho chen ye shes sku can pad+ma skyes/ /snyigs ma'i 'gro ba'i skyabs mchog mtshungs pa med/ /dpal ldan bla ma mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang*/ /'bral med bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du mchod/ /de la 'dir dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi spyi gzugs dpal o ḍi yā na'i slob dpon chen po pad+ma kā ras byin gyis rlabs pa la brten nas/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po'am pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa la ngo mtshar ba'i bka' babs bdun bzhugs pa'i nang tshan/ zab gter skor gyi smin grol dkyus gcig tu 'bogs pa'i skabs kyi bcas bsham gyi rim pa mdor bsdus su bkod pa la gsum/ spyir ji ltar bya ba'i lag len/ nyer mkho'i yo byad sta gon/ bye brag dbang rnams kyi gsham bkod bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'di nyid kyi smin grol bgyid par brtsam pa na/ slob dpon gyis rang gi rtsa ba'i yi dam mam dkyil 'khor spyi'i khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' lta bu'i bsnyen pa kha gso zhag bdun gyis nyung mthar byas te gnang ba stsol ba'i gsol ba gdab/ zhu ba po'i slob ma dad pa dam tshig thub nges nyams len dang 'chad spel nus pa ha cang mang po ma yin pa dgos te/ zhi khro rtsa gsum gu ru zhi ba thugs rje chen po sogs khyab gdal du bskur chog kyang zhu mkhan ha cang mang na lcogs thabs med pa dang*/ zab gnyan che ba'i rigs mang po la bskur mi rung ba 'ga' zhig brgyud 'dzin gcig gam gsum las mi spel bar gsungs pas dbye bsal thog ma nas phyed pa gal che'o/ /de nas dbang khrid ma tshugs pa'i snga rol du/ dpon slob thun mong nas rtsa ba gsum la tshogs skong dang sdig sgrib nyams chags sbyong ba yig brgya'i bsgom bzlas sogs gnang ba zhu zhing dge ba'i dpung bskyed ci 'grub tu byas pas gnas skabs bar chad mi 'byung ba dang phyin chad bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel du 'gyur ro/ /lag len dngos la rgyas pa sgrub chen gyi khong du btang ba dang*/

bsdus pa sgrub chen mi spel ba'i lugs gnyis bla slob 'khos dang longs skabs kyis gang lcogs bya chog cing gang ltar yang gza' skar dus tshes bzang po zhig la dbu btsugs/ dang po ltar na/ 'brel dang dgos pa'i gnad shin tu che ba'i dbang gis rigs kun khyab bdag dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs bka' gter zung 'jug smin lugs nyid kyis khog dbub dgos pas/ de'i sgrub khog rnam grol snye ma nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin/ nyin dang po'i snga dro sa chog nas mtshams gcod rjes 'brel bcas/ phyi dro lha sta gon dang rgyan bkod/ nyin gnyis par rdor sems sgrub mchod rgyas pa dzab bzlas nyul le skrod cing byin dbab pas mtshon sgrub chen gyi chings ji lta bar bya/ dgong mor grub thob bka' brgyad kyi sta gon grub par bya/ 'di phyin chad bsnyen rgyun 'khyol dka' yang rdor sems sgrub mchod ma chags pa dgos mod bla mas longs khyab med cing mi lcogs na gzhan pa'i bla grwa kha shas la nyin re bzhin gong ltar bsgrub bcol/ 'di nas brtsams mjug ma grub kyi bar dngos rol rjes 'brang gter srung rnams kyi gtor 'bul nyin re tshar re 'don mkhan zur du yod na legs/ dngos rol ma grub na dam can spyi gtor gyis go bcad/ sgrub gzhi yod pa'i gnas der go yul dogs na khang pa gzhan du mchod gtor rgyas bsdus gang lcogs la brten nas 'don chog go/ dgongs mo nas bka' brgyad dbang chas bshams la/ nyin gsum par dngos gzhi'i dbang rdzogs par bskur/ nyin bzhi par rtsa gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang bskur ba nas brtsam grangs gang thon bya ba las spar bkab med/ dgongs gter 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig gi dbang rjes su bzhag /dbang khrid yongs rdzogs grub pa'i nyin rdor sems cho ga rgyas par btang zhing sgrub pa'i dngos grub blang ba'i tshe slob dpon gzhan gyis mchog gi sbyin sreg bya zhing*/

de nas rdor sems kyi dbang rdzogs par byas la gtor ma btang ba sogs rjes rim rnams bya/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig gi dbang chas bsham nas las byang gis bsgrubs la tshe dbang rgyas bsdus rnams kyis mthar dge byas te de'i rjes chog dang*/ sgrub pa'i tho 'grol sogs sgrub khog las 'byung ba ltar mtha' rgyas su bya ba yin no/ /gnyis pa spros 'byor longs khoms med pa dag gis sgrub chen dang mi sbrel bar bskur na/ thog mar dgongs gter grub thob bka' brgyad kyi dbang chen dngos sta phyes te nyin gnyis la rdzogs par bskur/ de nas smin gling rdor sems kyi dbang*/ mjug srid pa ma mo'i gnad tig gi dbang grub kyi bar nyin re bzhin dbang rgyas bsdus dang bstun pa'i gang 'gro snga dro sgrub cing phyi dro bskur/ dbang sgrub thams cad la'ang bsnyen bzlas brgya rtsa las mi nyung ba dang*/ bum bzlas zur du dgos rigs la'ang de ltar bya/ gter srung sgos mchod yod rigs so so'i thad kar sbyar/ dmigs bsal med pa la las byang rjes ma dang 'brel bar dam can spyi gtor gter gzhi bcas tshar re ma btang thabs med pas de kas 'thus par byed/ bdag 'jug re re bzhin mi lcogs pas ting 'dzin dbang len sogs dmigs bsal bshad pa rnams de kas 'thus shing*/ spyi la rig pa'i me tog dor/ gang la'ang slob ma gzhug par gnang ba zhu ba ma chad pa gal che/ chos skyong srog gtad rnams dam ldan gtor 'bul sogs ma chags pa byed mkhan ma gtogs khyab brdal du spel mi rung*/ khrid ni so so'i dbang bskur grub pa'i rjes su bshad dgos pa rnams dbang grub rjes mtshams sbyor bcas maṇ+ḍal phul la khrid yig nyid dal bus go brda 'phrod par bklag nas dge bsngo sogs bya/ 'di la bshar khrid dam khrid lung sbrags ma zer/ bshad mi shes mkhan nas nyab nyob mang po bshad na don 'bras med cing nyi ma 'phul/ bshad shes mkhan yin kyang don rtsa khrid yig nang ma 'dus pa med cing rnams grangs mang po rdzogs thabs med pas 'di yis go chod par byed/

spyir kha bshad dpe klog gang byed kyang sgom don yid la nges shing go brda 'phrod pa khrid kyi mtshan nyid/ tshig don re re bzhin yid la zin mi dgos par sgra thos kyi shes 'jug bar ma chad pa tsam lung gi mtshan nyid yin pa chos spyan ldan pa'i bla ma dag bzhed pas de dag gi gnad kyang shes par bya dgos so/ /bklag lung ni dbang gi bar bar du grub na'ang legs shing mi lcogs na dbang rnams grub zin pa'i rjes su dkyus gcig tu bklags pas chog /gnyis pa nyer mkho'i yo byad sta gon ni 'di'i skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad snga tshags su bya dgos pa ni/ dkyil 'khor rnams kyi ras bris cha tshang dang*/ tsaka li cha tshang bcas med thabs med pas de dag tshogs pa gzhir byas/ rgyud dang gzhung pod kyi glegs bam so so la mkho ba 'dzom na rab/ ma 'dzom na rgyud gsang snying tsam dang so so'i sgrub thabs kyi yi ge dar gyis dril ba/ klong snying rig 'dzin srog 'khor/ sin+dhu ra/ li khri/ chos sman/ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar dang*/ rak+ta so lnga/ gtor ma'i spod sman bzang drug sogs sman sna/ tshe rdzas phur ma/ byin 'bebs sbyar spos/ sta gon rdzas so shing*/ de dor ba'i gdan ras bris pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang*/ ku sha/ dpung skud kha dog so so las 'byung ba ltar dang*/ cod paṇa kha dog lnga pa dang mig dar slob ma'i grangs mnyam/ cod paṇa dor ba'i gzhi ras la phyogs bzhi dbus lngar phyag rgya bris pa/ mig thur/ phyag shing*/ bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings ldan pa bcu las mi nyung ba/ gzungs rdor/ dung chos gnyis gsum/ dbu rgyan/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ rdor dril lhan cig bcings pa/ me long kha shas/ shel rdo stegs can che chung gnyis gsum/ bhan+dha mtshan ldan kha shas dang mo thod gcig tsam/ dar kha dog sna tshogs gang 'dzom/ dbang phreng dung ngam shel/ pad rāg /rak+sha'am thod phreng*/ gdab phur che chung*/ gri gug /lcags hom/ bya 'ug gi sgro/

tho ba sgrol gri gtun khung sogs bsgral chas tshang ba/ thun rdzas sna tshogs/ zlog 'khor spyi 'gro/ 'tshe yungs rtsang sogs zor chas/ rjes gnang la mkho ba'i gdugs dang phyag shing 'khor lo/ g.yab dar/ dgang gzar blugs dang sbyin sreg rdzas/ rdul tshon/ gu gul/ yungs kar/ til nag /sgrub chen dang sbrel na de'i chas sgab skor ral gri bzhi mda' bzhi phur bu bcu bzhi stegs bcas rgyal tho sogs dang*/ mi sbrel yang dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan rgyal mtshan bzhi dar phan bzhi sogs bkod na legs pas gang 'dzom/ sman raka dang zhi mchod drag mchod snod sbreng thur bcas/ chang phud/ yol ba/ tshe bum/ tshe mda'/ dbang skabs nyer mkho'i sman raka gtor gsum chung ngu snod gcig tu bzhag pa/ phyi mchod rnam bdun gcig tu bsgrigs pa/ stegs khebs che chung*/ ḍā dril rnga gling*/ rol chas sogs mdor na 'og tu dgos pa rnams thad kar bab dus mi shol bar zhib par bsgrig /dgos chas 'dang nges kyi mchod phye gtsang ma/ mar/ mchod 'bru/ mar me/ spos reng ngam spos phye dri ldan/ dkar gsum/ mngar gsum/ zas sna/ gos sna/ chang phud/ phyugs lta bu rang bzhin gyis shi ba'i gtor sha gtsang ma rnams kyang tshogs par bya'o/ /gsum pa bye brag so so'i gshom bkod bshad pa la'ang*/ thog mar dbang bskur tshugs nye ba'i nyin snga ma rnams su bka' brgyad kyis mtshon pa'i gtor ma 'og tu dgos pa rnams las thog mar mkho ba rnams dang*/ rtsa gsum spyi dang khyad par chos srung gter srung rnams re re bzhin 'phral 'phral gshom pa ma lcogs na/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro/ chos skyong dngos grub rol mtsho rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'am bsdu na dam can spyi'i gtor ma legs par bzhengs/ las byang la dgos pa'i mchod gtor rigs tshang bar gal che/ dngos gzhi tshugs pa'i thog mar gnas khang phyags dar bya/ rtsa ba gsum gyi sku gsung thugs kyi rten byin rlabs can rnams dang*/ chos skyong gi rten sogs bkram/

bla bre dar 'phan sogs rgyan gyi bkod pas mdzes par bya/ sgrub chen dang sbrel na dkyil 'khor lding khri brtsegs mar byas pa'i 'og tu rdor sems dkyil 'khor rgyun bzhag gi mtha' bskor du phyi nang mchod pa brgya rtsa sogs bsgrig /steng mar skabs so so'i dkyil 'khor dbang rdzas rnams res mos su bsham/ sgab skor sogs kyi chas rnams spyi ltar bya ba yin la/ sgrub chen dang ma 'brel na stegs bu rgya che ba khebs bzang pos bkab cing*/ dbang mang po sbrel skabs dkyil 'khor dang dbang rdzas rnams shong nges pa'i zur bzhi na rgyal mtshan dang*/ logs bzhir 'phan gzug /steng du bla bre dar gdangs kyis mdzes par brgyan/ de steng dkyil 'khor gang yin bkram pa'i dbus su bum gtor brtsegs mar 'god dgos pa'i rigs la 'phrul stegs rim pa gnyis pa blang bzhag bde ba dang*/ bum gtor gang rung 'jog dgos pa spyi dang*/ sku tshab bzhugs gdan sogs rkang gsum 'jog dgos pas de'ang grangs ka mang du bsdogs/ gal te dkyil 'khor ras bris mi 'dzoms pa'i dbang byin rlabs chung ngu'i rigs la maṇ+ḍal steng tshom bu lha grangs bkod kyang chog mod/ tshom bu'ang tshon gyis kha bsgyur ba'i 'bras la mar gyi snying po byas te lha mdog dang mtshungs par grub na legs/ bum pa la gsar ma'i lugs su gos bzang po dang srad bu sogs kyis dkri ba las dmigs su ma gsungs kyang*/ rnying ma gter ma'i phyogs phal mo cher mgul chings dmigs gsal du bshad cing da lta phyag len du'ang mdzad pas/ 'di man chad dmigs su ma bshad pa rnams la mgul chings lha gtso bo'i sku mdog dang mthun par bcings/ bum rdzas kyang spyi khyab thams cad bla med kho na yin pas so lnga 'ba' zhig dang dri bzang gi chu sbyar/ so so'i skabs smos pa bzhin dmigs bsal dag la nyer lnga dang sbyar/ byin rlabs kyi rigs sogs kyi thod pa'i bdud rtsi chang dang bdud rtsi chos sman sbyar/

rig tsaka yod pa'i dbang bzhi'i rigs rnams la de steng mngar gsum ro bro nges par bya/ tshe dbang gi rigs la tshe ril tshe chang mngar gsum dang sbyar zhing*/ yod na tshe rdzas phur ma'ang 'debs/ dbang gi bgegs bskrad la gu gul/ byin 'bebs la 'dzom na 'bebs rdzas/ med na sbyar spos dri zhim pos bdug pa sogs ma chad par bya'o/ /mig dar me tog sogs kyang blang bzhag bde bar byas te nam dgos kyi skabs maṇ+ḍal me tog bkram sdud dang lhan cig gtad chog par bya/ bka' brgyad lta bu'i dbang chen mtshams sbyar yod rigs la de dag bla mas brda sprad pa dang mnyam du 'gyed dgos/ spyir 'di dag gi skabs su las rdor bslab shes go ba phyag len zhib pa zhig gis bsham bkod rnams snga ma grub bstun de'i chas rnams bsdu zhing*/ phyi ma rnams 'phral 'phral mi shol ba bsgrigs thub pa dgos/ mchod g.yog lag bde zhig gis nyin re'i mchod gtor dkar bgegs/ chos srung rgyun 'bul gter gzhi/ las byang re re bzhin gtor gsos thebs kyu/ zhal zas/ tshogs/ chad brtan sogs spyi dang*/ bye brag gang dgos rnams bca'o/ /lag len rgyas bsdus gnyis ka la'ang gnas khang go yul yangs na sgrub dkyil dang bar mtshams bye ba'i rgyab phyogs su stegs bu rim pa gsum pa bstar dang po la/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong pho mo nor lha phyi rgyud bcas kyi gtor ma bdun tshar/ g.yas g.yon du sman raka phab ldan/ gnyis par dngos rol rjes 'brang chad brtan rgyun bzhag bcas/ gsum par zhi mchod drag mchod mjug sprod du bshams pa'i bar du mañdzi la chos skyong gtor spungs rgyun 'bul bkod/ 'di dag ni mchod gtor spyi khyab pa yin pas gtor 'bul nam byed la thebs kyu sogs kyis gso ba dang*/ mchod pa nyin re bzhin brje/ las byang snga phyi'i bar mtshams lta bu la kha gso/ go yul gyis 'di ltar ma shong na'ang dkyil 'khor sger mchod dang gtor ma bsham dgos pas de kas 'thus so/

༈ /de nas dbang bskur so so dang 'brel ba'i bshom bkod lag len dngos kyi dang po grub thob bka' brgyad kyi dbang la/ khyor chu/ so shing*/ dpung skud/ ku sha ste sta gon rdzas bzhi/ dkyil 'khor ras bris dbus mañdzi'i khar rnam bum so lnga'i bcud ldan mgul chings mthing ga kha rgyan ldan pa/ rdor sems dpal dgu bya khyung dpal mgon ma ning bcas kyi tsaka li bcu gnyis kha rgyan gseb tu bkod pa yin kyang mi bde na mdun du bzhag /dbu rgyan/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ ming dbang rdor dril/ sngags byang*/ gnam lcags rdo rje rnams dang*/ g.yas phyogs su sman gyi pho brang g.yon phyogs su sgrub phur mdun ngos su thod pa'i nang zan kong sdong bu dgu btsug pa'i mar me/ de'i g.yas su khrus kyi bum pa nyer lnga'i bcud ldan chings dkar kha rgyan dang bcas pa/ g.yon du bam phyag len ltar bcas pa/ /gang bder nus dbang chas pusti/ phreng ba/ dung dkar/ phyag shing*/ khri gdugs sogs kyi tsaka li so so ba/ bza' btung 'gyed bde/ rgyab mdun gang bder zangs lcags snod du dmar gtor gnyis la 'khor gtor chung ngam theb kyu sum cu dang bco brgyad kyis bskor ba la 'dzom na dregs pa'i sde dpon dang dregs pa bco brgyad kyi gtso bo'i tsaka li btsugs pa la dar gdugs dang sha khrag gis brgyan pa dang*/ srung ma'i 'khor lo/ las phur/ thun rdzas ri rab me hom zor gtor rnams phyogs bsdus/ tshe 'brang*/ tshe ril chang*/ gsang thod/ bdud rtsi rig tsaka /shel rdo rnams bkod legs su bkram/ lcags hom/ ling ga /ral gri sogs nyer mkho rnams tshogs par bya/ mig dar me tog chu nan phyag shing las bum rnams dbang phal mo cher spyi 'gro yin pas logs su ma smos pas shes dgos/ 'di yi dbang dpe pod/ ba)par bzhugs/ ༈ /de nas thog mar smin gling rdor sems thugs kyi sgrub pa la/ ras bris sam maṇ+ḍal la tshom bu gcig pa'i steng khri'ur bum pa/

thod pa'i bdud rtsi/ sin+dhu ra'i me long la chos 'byung lte bar mūm̐ yig bris pa dang shel rdo stegs ldan rnams brtsegs mar 'jog ༈ /sa gter skor las rtsa gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa la ras bris/ mañdzi'i khar rnam bum dang thod pa'i bdud rtsi/ rig tsag /rtsa gsum spyi 'gro'i gtor ma bcas/ ༈ /thugs chen sems nyid ngal gso la/ ras bris/ mañdzī khar rnam rgyal bum pa bcud ldan gyi khar bhañdza bdud rtsi'i gtams/ me long sin+dhū ra la chos 'byung bsnol ma'i lte bar/ hrīḥm/ ha ri ni sa/ ra tsa hri ya sa bon mjug sprod zhal sbyor gyi tshul du bkod pa dar dmar gyis bkab/ de steng rdo rje sems dpa'i me long rnams brtsegs mar bshams/ dkyil 'khor shar du khrus bum mgul chings dmar po/ lhor tshe bum/ tshe ril chang bcas/ nub tu thod par myong grol ril bu/ myos byed la sin+dhū ra btab pas bkang zhing dar dmar bkab/ byang du dpal gtor dmar po dar gdugs rta mgrin gyi sku tsaka can dang*/ za ma tog ril bu'i bkang ba bum pa'i rgyab tu bzhag /gzhan yang chu nan/ dbu rgyan/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ rdor dril bsnol ma/ lha tsaka yongs rdzogs/ sngags byang*/ me long rdo rje/ zhi chas/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ sgom dbang rten dkyil 'khor/ nyan dbang glegs bam/ sgrub dbang phreng ba bcas/ ༈ /phyi sgrub bar chad kun sel dbang rgyas pa 'dir mi bzhugs/ ༈ /'bring bsdus la ras bris sam tshom bu lha grangs mañdzi'i khar rnam bum dang thod pa'i bdud rtsi me long sin+dhu ra'i thig le hrīḥyig bris pa brtsegs mar bkod/ g.yas su gtor ma rin chen zur brgyad ma/ g.yon du gu ru'i sku tshab/ dbus sogs su lha tsaka tshang ba/ dbang phreng*/ me long*/ mtha' rten tshe dbang bskur na tshe bum tshe ril chang mda' dar bcas/ ༈ /thugs sgrub bla ma nor lha la dkyil 'khor ras bris sam tshom bu dbus su gtso 'khor dgu/ grwa bzhi dang sgo bzhir bzhi re bkod pa'i dbus steng khri'ur 'dzom na gzhung mthun bca' sgrub byas pa'i gter bum dang ma 'dzom na gtor ma gzhung mthun/

g.yas su rin po che'i snod du mngar gsum sbyar ba'i chang*/ g.yon du zas sna gos sna/ rgyab tu mda' dang*/ sku gsung thugs dbang sbyor na lha tsaka bcu bdun/ sngags byang*/ me long*/ rdzas rtags sna bdun bcas bkod/ ༈ /thugs sgrub rak+sha thod phreng la maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dbus su gcig 'khor bcus bskor ba'i steng rnam bum/ mdun du dpal gtor/ sku tsaka /sngags byang ngam thod phreng*/ phyag mtshan rdo rje thod pa'i tsaka li bcas/ ༈ /thugs sgrub sgrol ljang 'jigs pa kun sel la ras bris sam maṇ+ḍal tshom bu nyer gcig pa'i dbus su rnam bum/ mdun du dbang gtor cog zlum dkar po rgyan ldan/ sku brnyan/ shel phreng*/ phyag mtshan ut+pal ljang gu rnams ji ltar bde ba bkod/ ༈ /nang sgrub yid bzhin nor bu'am bsam lhun dbang rgyas pa la ras bris stegs khar rnam bum thod chang me long sin+dhu ra'i thig le lnga tshom baṃ ha ri ni sas mtshan pa gu ru'i sku 'bag rnams brtsegs/ lha tsaka /sngags byang tshang ma/ me long*/ lha gnas thad kar dngos grub kyi rdzas bcu gsum dngos sam tsaka li/ rgyab ngos su bla ma'i gtor chen gong mtshungs rig tsaka mtha' rten tshe dbang bskur na de'i chas gong mtshungs rnams bkod/ ༈ /rtsa dbang 'bring po la dngos grub rdzas bcu gsum dang rig tsaka mi dgos gzhan dbang chen dang 'dra/ gtor chen mdun du bkod/ ༈ /gtor dbang la maṇ+ḍal steng gtor chen kho na bzhag ༈ /tshe dbang zung 'brel du byed na maṇ+ḍal la de'i chas rnams bsgrig ༈ /gter gsar 'khor ba dong sprugs la/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte bar hrīḥdamar bris pa'i steng rnam bum thod chang me long hrīḥdamar bris pa rnams brtsegs la dar dmar gyis bkab/ mdun du myang grol dbang ril bu bum pa/ rgyab tu dpal gtor rgyan ldan bzhag ༈ /rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i rje btsun sgrol ma la/ ras bris/ gtor ma dkar zlum/ mañdzi'i khar bum pa thod chang*/ me long la sin+dhu rar sngags phreng gis bskor ba/

shel rdo/ dbu rgyan/ rdor dril/ sku tsaka /sngags phreng*/ me long*/ bkra shis rdzas rtags sna bdun so sor phyogs bsdus bcas/ ༈ /rtsa gsum spyi 'dus la/ ras bris sam 'bru tshom gtso bo gsum/ de rgyab sgo ba bzhi bcas bkod pa'i steng du khri'ur rnam bum/ mdun du lha tsaka bzhi/ g.yas su gsang thod/ g.yon du shel rdo me long dbang phreng*/ rgyab tu tshe 'brang*/ tshe ril chang mda' dar bcas bkod/ ༈ /rtsa gsum sgyu 'phrul drwa ba la/ ras bris/ de steng khri'u la gter bum mam ma 'byor na/ bum pa nyer lnga'i rdzas ldan chings ser kha rgyan can bkod/ dbus su gtso bo'i sku rten/ g.yas su sngags byang gser bris/ rgyab tu phyag mtshan bi dza pu ra dang 'bras snye/ g.yon du rin chen dar gos dang*/ bkra shis rdzas rtags zas sna tshogs/ gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba'i dbyibs can ser po/ dar gdugs ser pos spras shing zas sna bzang pos bskor ba bcas/ ༈ /yang gter rtsa gsum dril sgrub la stegs bur me tog sil ma bkram pa'i dbus su bla gtor dmar zlum rgyan ldan dar gdugs bcas pa/ mdun du tshe 'brang*/ g.yas g.yon tshe ril chang bcas/ ༈ /nyi ma seng ge'i pad+ma rgyal po la/ sta gon rdzas bzhi/ dkyil 'khor ras bris steng rnam bum chings dmar can gyi khar thod chang sin+dhu ra'i me long la yig bdun bris pas bkab/ de'i steng 'phrul stegs la bla ma'i gtor chen/ mdun sogs su myong grol ril bum/ dbu rgyan/ rdor dril ming dbang*/ lha tsaka tshang ba/ phreng dmar/ me long*/ rgya gram bcas bkod/ ༈ /don dbang la/ dkyil 'khor dbus su bum pa/ g.yas g.yon du ril bum dang*/ bla gtor/ mdun du thod chang dang me long bzhag /rtsa dbang dang sbrel skabs bsham bkod zur du mi dgos/ ༈ /de'i tshe dbang la dkyil 'khor ram tshom bu dmar po lha grangs kyi dbus su rnam bum chings dmar tshe rdzas kyi bcud ldan/ g.yas su tshe ril/ g.yon du tshe chang*/

mdun du tshe 'brang*/ rgyab tu tshe mda' bkod la gzungs thag gis sbrel/ ༈ /rgya lo tsā'i bla ma bstan gnyis skor gsum rtsa dbang la/ dkyil 'khor ras bris dbus rnam bum/ de'i don dbang la/ ras bris sam tshom bu lha grangs steng rnam bum/ g.yas g.yon du gsang thod/ rig tsaka /shel rdo/ mdun rgyab gang bder tshe 'brang*/ tshe ril chang*/ mda' dar/ dbang phreng bkod/ ༈ /rong zom chos bzang mkha' 'gro ma rig byed rtsal la dkyil 'khor ram tshom bu gtso 'khor lnga pa'i steng bum pa chings dmar dbang gi ril bu'i rdzas ldan khar bhan+dha bdud rtsis bkang ba la/ sin+dhu ra'i me long chos 'byung gi dbus hrīḥdang phyogs bzhir ha ri ni sa bris pas bkab/ dar dmar gyi gur phub/ ༈ /o rgyan gling pa'i bka' 'dus don dbang la/ ras bris steng dbus 'bru lnga*/ shar sman lnga/ lhor rin chen lnga/ nub dri lnga/ byang snying po lnga rnams kyi bum pa snod gcig tu bzhag pa/ mdun du zhi ba rdor 'chang dang*/ gtso bo nyer gcig gi tsaka li/ bgrang phreng*/ g.yas su sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga so sor sbyar ba'i thod pa lnga snod gcig tu bzhag pa/ g.yon du rig ma'i gzugs dkar ser dmar ljang mthing lnga/ 'ja' shel/ rgyab phyogs su dpal gtor rgyan ldan bzhag /bsdu na bum thod rig tsaka rnams gcig la bsdu zhing lha dbang la sbyar yang chog ༈ /mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus rtsa dbang la/ dkyil 'khor ras bris dbus mañdzi'i khar thod pa mtshan ldan chang la bdud rtsi lnga sbyar bas bkang ba'i khar/ sin+dhu ra'i me long la chos 'byung bsnol ma'i lte bar bam̐/ mtha' bskor du thugs gsung sku'i sngags rim pa gsum du bskor bas bkab pa'i steng du shel rdo/ mdun du gtso 'khor so bdun gyi lha tsaka /phyogs gang bder gsang dbang thod pa'i bdud rtsi/ dpal 'bar/ me long gsal ba/ gtso mo'i sku tsaka /mda' gzhu/ mar me/ rig tsaka rnams dang rjes gnang chas/ phreng ba/ dung*/

glegs bam/ dur khrod chas brgyad sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu thod chang du blugs pa'am ma 'dzom na gzugs brnyan bris pa bcas bkod/ bka' srung bka' gtad la gtor ma zur gsum gtso 'khor gsum pa dar gdugs can yang bkod/ ༈ /gtor dbang la gtor ma gzhung gsal sku tsaka dar gdugs kyis brgyan pa dkyil 'khor kyi dbus su bkod/ snga ma'i zhar byung byed na dkyil 'khor rgyab phyogs lta bur bzhag /gnyis ka la'ang slob ma la sbyin rgyu zas sna dang thod chang lhan cig tu bkod do/ ༈ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshe sgrub sogs bzhi la/ 'dzom na ras bris dkyil 'khor/ ma 'dzom na mkha' 'gro bzhi la rim bzhin tshom bu lha mdog bkod pa'i steng so so'i dbang rdzas bsham dgos pas/ 'di la tshom bu dkar po gcig /de steng tshe 'brang*/ g.yas g.yon du tshe ril chang dang mda' dar bkod/ ༈ /rin chen mkha' 'gro'i nor sgrub la/ gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba'i dbyibs can nor bu mig gsum mang pos mdzes par bskor ba rgyan spros dar gdugs ser po can/ g.yas su thod pa'i bdud rtsi/ g.yon du thod pa mtshan ldan 'khor lo gzhung gsal dang g.yang rdzas sna tshogs pas bkang ba bzhag ༈ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i dbang sdud la/ sku rten bris sku/ gsung rten srog 'khor/ thugs rten bhan+dhar dbang gi ril bus bkang ba rnams gzhung mthun byas la g.yas g.yon mdun gsum du bkod/ dbang gi me thab/ yam shing*/ mar khu/ mngar gsum la rdzas sbyar gyi ril bu/ me tog dmar po chang gis sbags pa/ lan tshwa bcas sreg rdzas rnams dang*/ dgang blugs/ gser skyems mchod pa bcas 'du bya/ ༈ /las kyi mkha' 'gro'i zor dbang la/ zangs lcags kyi snod du zor gtor khro mo'i zhal can gtor chung lha grangs nyer gnyis kyis bskor ba/ de rgyab zor kong zur gsum brgyad la/ shar du yungs kar/ lhor rtsang*/ nub tu dug /byang du rdo/ shar lhor me/ lho nub dug khrag /nub byang mda'/

byang shar phung sa'i zor rnams bkod/ 'tshe nyungs sha khrag gis brgyan cing*/ dar nag gi gdugs phub la/ g.yas g.yon du/ sngags byang dang*/ gnam lcags rdo rje bzhag /phyag rgya bzhi'i chas/ hom dang liṅga/ byad thag /dug khrag /bsgral phur/ rtse gsum/ gri gug /thod ngan du khrag thun sbyar ba rnams nye bar bsdog go/ ༈ /dag snang drang srong dri med la maṇ+ḍal pad 'dab bzhi tshom bu gcig pa'i khar rnam bum/ sku tsaka /g.yas su tshe ril/ g.yon du tshe chang*/ mdun du 'bul gtor dkar zlum shing tog dkar mngar gyis brgyan pa/ ༈ /ra mo shel sman gyi yang gter rdo rje bdud rtsi'i bla ma'i gtor dbang la maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dkar po gcig bkod pa'i steng mañdzi'i khar bla gtor rin chen 'bar ba sku tsaka dar gdugs bcas bkod/ ༈ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i dbang la sta gon rdzas bzhi dkyil 'khor bkram pa'i dbus su rnam bum chings ljang can gyi khar thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba la sin+dhu ra'i me long dga' 'khyil bam̐ yig gis mtshan pas bkab la dar gur dbub/ mdun sogs su dbu rgyan/ rdo rje'i dril bu/ rdor dril/ thod chang rnams dang*/ shar du khrus bum/ lhor bdug pa/ nub tu ma da na btab pa'i chang*/ byang du thod par bdud rtsi ril bu bcas sngar nas so so'i sgrub pa thems pa can bkod/ sin+dhu ra dang zhun mar dgang blugs dung dkar dril bu glegs bam rnams kyang bsdog ༈ /dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi yan lag lha gsum gyi rjes gnang rtsa dbang dang sbrel skabs bca' bsham logs su mi dgos/ ༈ /gter bdag sngags srung ma'i srog gtad la chos 'byung 'khor lo mthing nag rtsibs bzhi pa/ me ri phrag mtshos bskor ba'i lte bar thig le mthing nag rtsibs bzhi dkar ser dmar ljang bkod pa'i tshom bu gtso 'khor lnga pa'i steng du rten gtor sku gzugs dar gdugs kyis spras pa dang sngags byang bkod/ ༈ /sman bla longs sku'i gtor dbang la 'bru tshom lnga'i steng dpal gtor/

g.yas g.yon du dkar gtor dmar gtor bcas so/ ༈ /o rgyan dri med kun dga'i yang gter rgyal ba rgya mtsho la/ sta gon rdzas bzhi/ dkyil 'khor ras bris sam 'bru tshom lha grangs dbus su khri'u'i khar thod pa mtshan ldan myang grol ril bus phyur bur bkang ba dar dmar gyis bkab pa'i steng*/ sin+dhu ra'i me long sngags byang bris pa bzhag mdun sogs phyogs mtshams rnams su rnam bum/ dbu rgyan/ rdor dril/ gtso 'khor rnams kyi lha tsaka dgu/ sngags byang phreng dmar/ me long*/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ glegs bam/ phrin las bzhi'i 'brang rgyas snod gcig bsdus/ gsang thod/ rig tsaka rnams bkod/ ril bu dang byang sems dkar dmar sin+dhu ra rnams sbyar ba'i thig le bkod rgyu dang*/ mgul la btags rgyu myang grol thum bu slob ma'i grangs mnyam sogs bsdog go/ ༈ /dri med thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu la/ dkyil 'khor dbus su bum pa ching sngon can/ mdun du lha tsaka brgyad/ g.yas g.yon du bla ma'i sku 'bag dang gtor ma rin chen zur brgyad/ gsang thod/ rig tsaka /dbang phreng*/ me long rdo rje/ tshe 'brang*/ tshe ril chang bcas bkod/ ༈ /yang gter bla ma bde mchog 'khor lo la dkyil 'khor ras bris sam maṇ+ḍal la tshom bu dmar po gcig bkod pa'i khar mañdzi'i steng bum pa so lnga'i bcud ldan mgul chings dmar po kha rgyan dang bcas pa bkod/ mdun du gtso 'khor lha tsaka bdun/ dbang phreng dmar po/ me long*/ rgyab tu gsang dbang thod chang dang rig tsaka /g.yas su sman gyi pho brang chas ldan/ g.yon du tshe 'brang dang thod snod du tshe chang*/ tshe ril rnams bkod/ ༈ /zhi byed skor bdun la thun mong du/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad tshom bu dkar po can gyi steng du bum pa chings dkar nyer lnga'i bcud ldan/ 'dun rgyab gang bder zlum gtor dar gdugs dkar pos spras pa/ so so'i sku tsaka dang*/ phyag mtshan/ shel phreng*/

dar dang rin po che'i rgyan/ rdzas brgyad bcas/ skor bdun dus gcig sgrub bskur byed na de 'dra tshar bdun bsham/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par dang po spyan ma la ril bu tshad ldan bsgrubs pa'am med na a ru ra slob ma'i grangs mnyam dang khrus chas/ ༈ /gnyis pa lo ma can la de'i sman ril lam/ spru nag shu dag gu gul la sngags btab pa/ ༈ /gsum pa 'od zer can ma la sing ldeng dbyug pa rdo rje tog can/ ༈ /bzhi pa gtsug tor la phur bu byad dkrol chas/ tshon skud/ gri gsar pa/ yungs dkar/ me hom/ khrus chas/ glud gtor sogs bsdog ༈ /lnga pa sher phyin dkar mor bsgrubs pa'i sman mar ram/ shu dag dkar po sngags bzlas/ ༈ /drug pa sgrol dkar la/ phyag rgya bcings pas chog ༈ /bdun pa rma bya chen mor/ tshe 'brang ril chang rnams bkod/ 'chi bslu'i glud changs bu bcas pa dang khrus chas kyang nyer bsdogs bya'o/ ༈ /bal po āḥhūm̐ dzaṃ nag la dkyil 'khor ram tshom bu gtso 'khor dgu/ de rgyab bzhi bkod pa'i dbus su thugs rten thod pa dum gsum nyer lnga sogs kyi bcud ldan nang gsung rten srog 'khor dar gyis dril ba'i rgyab tu sku rten bcas bzhugs/ steng du bum pa chings sngon can/ g.yas su rin chen snod du gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba zas sna bcas/ g.yon du rin chen dar gos/ g.yang rdzas sna tshogs/ rgyab tu mda' dar/ tshe 'brang*/ ril chang*/ rdzas rtags rgyal srid bcas bzhag ༈ /mnga' bdag mol mi 'khyil gyi rta mgrin dpa' gcig la maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dmar po gcig gi steng seng ldeng dbyug to thod skam rdo rjes mtshan pa gzungs ldan/ g.yas g.yon du me zhags dang me long*/ dpal 'bar dmar po rtse gsum bcas/ ༈ /g.yag phyar sngon mo'i sgrol ljang la maṇ+ḍal tshom bu ljang gu gcig bkod pa'i steng mañdzi la bum pa nyer lnga'i rdzas dang chings ljang can/ mdun du dbang gtor dkar zlum/ sku tsaka /sngags phreng*/ ut+pal ljang gu'i tsaka li bcas bkod/

༈ /dbu ru ston shāka kyi rdo rje me 'bar la/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu sngo nag gcig pa'i steng rnam bum/ mdun du gtso 'khor bzhi'i tsaka li/ g.yas su rak+sha'i phreng ba/ g.yon du dpal gtor dar gdugs bcas/ ༈ /bka' brgyad dregs pa kun 'dul la/ ras bris steng mañdzi la bum pa rdzas so lnga can/ shar du dpal gtor gtso 'khor dgu dang sman rag /dpal gyi lha tsaka tshang ba/ lhor dbu rgyan/ nub tu rdor dril/ dur khrod dpal chas/ byang du thod chang*/ rig tsaka /shel rdo/ las phur bcas/ ༈ /phag dkar ye shes 'khor lo la/ sku mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor gzhung mthun bris pa'am/ maṇ+ḍal la me tog dkar po'i tshom bu gcig bkod pa'i steng khri'u la gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor ka pā la a mṛ ta'i bcud ldan gyi khar/ thugs me long la sin+dhu ra brdal bar chos 'byung bsnol ma'i dbus su hrīḥgru bzhir dga' 'khyil re re bris pas dgab/ mdun du sku tsaka /shel phreng*/ kha ṭ+wām̐/ sgrub yig /sna tshogs rdo rje dang bdud rtsi/ g.yas su thod pa mtshan ldan gzhung mthun tshe ril gyis bkang ba'i kha dar dmar gyis bkab pa dang tshe 'brang dkar mngar bza' btung*/ g.yon du bdud rtsi ril bus bkang ba'i sman gyi pho brang*/ skong chog dbang rten mar me rnams bkod/ ༈ /mi 'gyur las gling pad+ma gtum po la tshom bu gcig steng bum pa chings dmar kha rgyan sku tsaka gis brgyan pa/ mdun du dpal gtor/ g.yas su me long la bsnyen sngags mtshal bris can/ g.yon du rdo rje/ rgyab tu lcags kyu phur pa rnams bsham/ bsgral dbang byed na ling ga gdab phur sogs kyang bsdog ༈ /ra zhi pad 'dzin khyung khra la dkyil 'khor ram tshom bu gtso 'khor lnga pa'i steng rnam bum/ g.yas su thod chang*/ g.yon du me long*/ rgyab tu khyung lnga'i ril bu slob ma'i grangs mnyam sbyin rgyu dang rke la 'dogs rgyu'i thum po bcas/ ༈ /gter ston dbon gsas khyung thog rtsal gyi yang gter/

rdzogs chen kun bzang snying thig las/ tshe sgrub ye shes srog tig gi dbang la dkyil 'khor ram maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dmar po gcig bkod pa'i khar mañdzi la bum pa nyer lnga'i bcud dang chas ldan/ mdun du tshe 'brang*/ g.yas su tshe ril/ g.yon du tshe chang*/ rgyab tu mda' dar bcas bkod/ ༈ /rta'u rog rje gling pa'i rta mgrin yid bzhin 'bar ba'i tshe sgrub gsang ba rmad byung la/ zhi dkyil lam maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte bar sku'am tshe bum bris pa'i dbus su mañdzi'i khar bum pa nyer lnga'i bcud ldan mgul chings dmar po kha rgyan bcas/ mdun du dpal gtor rta mgrin gyi sku tsaka btsugs pa/ bum pa'i g.yas g.yon du tshe ril/ tshe chang*/ gtor ma'i g.yas g.yon du phreng ba/ rdo rje bzhag ༈ /nyang gter mtsho skyes rdo rje la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor ram ma 'dzom na maṇ+ḍal la 'bru dkar gyi tshom bu lha grangs bkod pa'i dbus su mañdzi la rin po che'i bum pa chas bcud ldan pa'i khar thod pa bdud rtsis gang bar gzhung gsal tshe rdzas sum cu'i ril bu gtab pa'i khar me long la sin+dhu ras chos 'byung gnyis brtsegs kyi dbus su hrīḥl rtsa sngags dang badz+ra gu rus bskor ba dang*/ chos 'byung gi zur drug la g.yung drung re bris pas bkab pa'i steng du dar dmar po'i gur phub pa la gzungs thag rdo rje btags pa dang de'i g.yas su tshe rgyas rin po che zur brgyad pa'i rnam pa can ril bus bskor ba dang*/ g.yon du dpal gtor rin po che 'bar ba'i rnam pa can pad+ma 'dab bzhis bskor ba rnams bkod/ dbang bskur ba'i 'khor lo gzhung gsal bris nas bltebs chings g.yogs bcas byas pa 'dzom na slob ma'i grangs mnyam pa dbus kyi bum pa la brten te dgod/ gzhan yang tshe ril chang*/ tshe mda'/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad rnams kyang dgod/ ༈ /nyang gter thugs rje chen po 'gro 'dul la/ sta gon rdzas bzhi/ khrus dbang la maṇ+ḍal me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa'i khar bum pa dri chab nyer lnga'i rdzas dang chu shel gyi bcud ldan mgul chings dkar po kha rgyan rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan dang bcas pa bkod/

bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rgyal po sogs rin chen brgyad kyi tsaka li'ang bzhag /dngos bzhi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bkram pa'i dbus su khri'u rnam bum nyer lnga'i rdzas dang chings dkar can bzhag /de'i khar thod pa mtshan ldan chang dang a mṛ tas bkang ba'i steng me long la mtshal lam sin+dhu ras yig drug bris pas bkab/ nang dbang rdzas/ dbu rgyan/ cod pan/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ shel phreng*/ sba lcags tshigs gsum/ khyad par rdzas/ lha tsaka nyer gnyis/ dngul gyis bris pa'i yig drug /pusti/ khri gdugs tsaka li rnams ci bder bkod/ phrin las bzhi'i dbang rdzas shar du dngul bum nang dri sman rin po che chu sna 'o mas bkang ba chu shel dang bcas pa/ mgul chings dkar po kha rgyan me long ldan pa/ lhor tshogs gtor/ dkar gsum/ mngar gsum khur ba/ sha btsos sregs rlon pa dang bcas pa/ nub tu zangs gzhong du dbang gtor zla gam dmar po rgya skyeg dang sin+dhu ras byugs shig chang dang sman sna bcas pa/ byang du zangs sam seng ldeng phur pa rta zhal can/ mdun ngos su tshe bum mgul chings dmar po dri chab dang so lngas bkang ba'i khar tshe'i 'brang rgyas bzhag pa dang tshe ril tshe chang*/ rgyab tu sman gyi pho brang rnams kyang de dag gi dbang bskur ched du bkod/ las byang nas bshad pa'i las bzhi'i 'bul gtor sogs tshogs par bya'o/ ༈ /sprul sku ra shag chen po'i ma mo sgang shar la sta gon rdzas bzhi dang mchod pa lnga*/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor steng phyogs bzhi dbus lngar thod pa chang gis bkang ba lnga'i nang du bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu so so yod na dbang gzhung ltar so sor btab/ med na thams cad la chos sman btab pa bkod/ mdun du gtso 'khor bdun cu rtsa drug gi lha tsaka tshang ba/ phyag mtshan/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi/ sha chen/ thod rnga/ mda' gzhu/ phur pa/ ral gri mtshon cha'i 'khor lo rnams dngos sam phyogs bsdus kyi tsaka li/ g.yas su dbu rgyan cod pan rgyab tu rdo rje rtse dgu/

de'i g.yon du dril bu/ bar mtshams su gsang thod mngar gsum sman sbyar/ rig tsaka /dur khrod chas tsaka /rjes gnang me long*/ ral gri nas 'khor lo'i bar phyag mtshan lnga*/ rkang gling bcas bzhag go/ ༈ /byang gling kun bzang thugs gter gyi bla sgrub rtsa dbang la/ sta gon rdzas bzhi/ til sbyong*/ dkyil 'khor ras bris sam tshom bu dbus su gcig /de rgyab brgyad rim bzhi/ de rgyab phyogs bzhir bzhi bkod pa'i dbus su rnam bum chings sngon/ dbu rgyan/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ rdor dril/ slob dpon dbang chas dung 'khor lo sogs mdor bsdus/ gsang thod/ me long sin+dhu ra'i thig le can/ kha ṭ+wām̐ ḍār dril bcas bkod/ ༈ /don dbang la tshom bu'i steng bla gtor/ g.yas g.yon du thod pa'i bdud rtsi/ sin+dhu ra'i me long bcas/ ༈ /rtsa dbang mjug gi spu gri mched gsum dmar gtor gsum dar gdugs can/ dam can gtor ma mkhar thabs can spyi 'gro bkod/ ༈ /byang gling zhi khro phur gsum la/ sta gon rdzas bzhi/ mchod pa bzhi bsnol/ dkyil 'khor ram tshom bu dbus dang mdun du che chung gnyis bkod pa'i steng mañdzi'i khar 'bru snod du yang dag thod sku/ de'i g.yas g.yon du ru lu'i sngags byang*/ mar me rnams bkod/ de steng 'phrul stegs la rnam bum so lnga'i bcud ldan chings sngon kha rgyan bcas/ mtha' bskor du/ zhi ba'i phan dbang chas la/ kun bzang yab yum/ zhi lha tshang ba'am rigs lnga yab yum/ dpa' bo 'bru lnga/ dbu rgyan/ rnam bum/ rin chen phreng*/ dar dmar mthing cod pan/ rdo rje'i go khrab rgyal mtshan/ gdugs/ bza' bca' btung ba rnams dang*/ nus dbang chas glegs bam/ phreng ba/ rgya gram/ dung phyag shing*/ 'khor lo/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan phyogs bsdus/ khro dbang chas thod skam dbu rgyan/ rdor dril/ kha ṭ+wām̐ rnge'u chung*/ thod khrag /rgyu zhags/ khyung*/ khrag zhag thal gsum/ thod pa tshar gsum/ sbrul chun/ glang zhing stag lpags/ rdo rje'i gshog pa/

ral mthing*/ me phung*/ khrag 'thung rigs lnga/ thod pa bdud rtsi lngas bkang ba/ mdun du sras mchog /phur bu/ nyungs gur rak+ta/ phreng ba dang 'dod yon lnga/ lcags kyu zhags pa ral gri mnan sreg 'phang chas/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan dril bu bcas phyogs bsdus/ rgyab sogs su gsang thod/ rig tsaka mgon po dang lha mo'i gtor ma dar gdugs mthing nag can bkod/ ༈ /de'i cha lag tshe sgrub sman mar gyi dbang la/ dkyil 'khor ci rigs dbus bum pa'i khar thod pa bcud len sman mar ril bus bkang ba kha rdo rje rgya gram gyis bcad pa bzhag go/ ༈ /gru gu yang dbang rta mgrin dregs pa kun sgrol la/ dkyil 'khor steng phur bu rta zhal can/ yungs kar dang cod pan gdags pa phur stegs la gzug /de steng 'phrul stegs la bum pa chings dmar kha rgyan la gtso bo yab yum dang khyung tsaka bcas pa/ de steng thod pa'i bdud rtsi dar dmar gyi khebs ldan/ mdun sogs su lha tsaka cha tshang*/ rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan/ rig tsaka /bud+dha he ru ka /'bru gsum dkar dmar mthing gsum/ me long*/ shel rdo me phung*/ dur khrod chas so so ba/ rdzas rgod dong bu/ rdor dril/ thod rnga/ rkang gling*/ sman raka gtor gsum/ gzhung pod bcas/ ༈ /dregs pa bco brgyad rjes gnang la/ dkyil 'khor dbus su stegs bur dpal chen po'i sku dang bum pa/ shar du dpal gtor/ lhor rwa srung*/ nub tu mthing shog la sngags byang li khris bris pa/ byang du phur pa khro zhal can/ rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dang me tog phreng ba/ dregs pa bco brgyad kyi sku tsaka /gtor chung zur gsum de grangs/ dregs pa'i gtor chen kyang gzhi mdun bkod/ ༈ /rdor gling bla ma bka' brgyad 'dus pa la/ so shing*/ srung skud sna lnga/ ku sha rnams bsdogs/ dkyil 'khor sgo rdzogs sam bla ma'i pho brang gnam 'bab ma'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su rnam rgyal bum pa'i kha rgyan la thod phreng rtsal dang rta phag yab yum gyi sku tsaka gis brgyan pa dang*/

de mnyam thod phreng sde lnga dang mkha' 'gro rigs lnga yab yum phyogs bsdus kyi tsakli bzhag /de ltar 'phrul stegs la bhan dha mtshan bzang dum gcig pa 'bru sman gyis bkang ba'i nang du gsang 'dus yab yum gyi sku bzhag /de steng mañdzi la gtor ma rin chen zur brgyad dar gdugs kyis spras pa bkod/ shar du dpal gtor gu ru za hor ma'i sku/ lhor thod pa'i snod du dpal gtor dang*/ blo ldan mchog sred/ nub tu rma bya'i sgro/ mar me/ nyi ma 'od zer/ byang du ka pā' la chang gis bkang ba/ me long dang*/ seng ge sgra sgrog /shar lhor thod chang dang pad+ma sam+bha/ lho nub tu me long dang pad+ma rgyal po/ /nub byang du rdor dril dang shākya seng ge/ /byang shar du seng ldeng phur pa/ o rgyan dang*/ rdo rje gro lod rnams kyi sku tsaka /mdun du me long*/ gtor ma la sku tsaka dar gdugs can dang*/ phur pa/ ral gri rnams bzhag /gzhan gang bder gsang rdzas thod chang*/ rig tsaka /chos bka' 'di nyid kyi glegs bam dang cod pan/ mar me/ bur chang*/ pad+ma 'dab drug steng mchod rten bang rim dgu pa/ rgyal srid dang rtags brgyad so sor bris pa rnams kyang bkod/ shar du chu gnyis nyer spyod/ lhor drag mchod/ nub tu sman gtor rak+ta/ byang du tshogs kyi yo byad rnams bsham/ ༈ /don dbang la dkyil 'khor dbus khri'u'i steng rnam bum mgul chings bcud dang ldan pa'i khar thod pa bdud rtsi la a mṛ tas bkang ba bzhag la me long sin+dhu ra'i thig le lnga tshom gyis brgyan pas bkab/ de steng shel rdo dang gu ru'i sku tshab bzhugs su gsol/ mdun rgyab gang bder gtor ma rin chen zur brgyad sku tsaka dar gdugs kyis brgyan pa bkod/ ༈ /rdor gling hūm̐ skor snying thig gi pho sgrub dang 'brel ba bum pa'i dbang la/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab bzhi 'ja' ris mu khyud lnga ldan gyis bskor ba'i dbus su bum pa so lnga'i rdzas dang bcud ldan mgul chings dkar po kha rgyan gyis spras pa/

pad 'dab shar du ting phor chus bkang ba/ lhor sa gru bzhi/ nub tu mar me/ byang du rlung g.yab rnams bzhag /de'i rgyab phyogs bla ma'i gtor chen bsham/ sngon 'gro sbyin sreg la zhi ba'i me thab spyi 'gre bris pa'am thab stegs dkar zlum 'bru tshom dkar po gtso 'khor lnga bkod pa'i khar bud shing zlum por brtsigs/ slob dpon gyi g.yon phyogs su 'bul gtor dkar zlum dang sman raka chu gnyis nyer spyod/ g.yas phyogs su ba lu sogs kyi yam shing bdun nam nyer gcig /mar khu/ til dang yungs kar rnams bkod/ ༈ /gnyis pa zung 'jug dang 'brel bar gsang dbang la/ dkyil 'khor sgo rdzogs sam phyogs mdog gi thig le lnga tshom re re bzhin 'ja' ris kyi mu khyud lnga dang mtha' bskor mu khyud 'ja' ris sna lngas bskor ba'i dbus su/ bum pa so lnga dang sbrang chang gi bcud ldan kha rgyan mgul chings dkar pos spras pa/ shar du rdo rje/ lhor rin chen 'bar ba/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gri rnams dang*/ rigs lnga yab yum gyi tsaka li/ bgrang phreng*/ dbyangs gsal dang*/ 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi sngags byang rnams bzhag /rgyab phyogs su yi dam gyi gtor chen bsham/ ༈ /gsum pa mo sgrub dang 'brel bar sher dbang la/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i steng du thod pa'i bdud rtsi chos sman mngar gsum sbyar ba dang rdor dril/ rta mgrin he ru ka'i sku tsaka dang rgyab ngos mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma bsham/ ༈ /bzhi pa tshig dbang la/ dkyil 'khor 'ja' ris kyi thig le nyi shu rtsa lnga'i mthar mu khyud 'ja' tshon gyis bskor ba'i dbus su shel rdo dang rma bya'i mdongs bzhag ༈ /lnga pa gdams gtad dbang la bsham bkod zur du mi dgos/ bum pa sogs dbang chas rnams snod gcig tu bsdu dgos pa dang gzhung pod glegs bam gtod rgyur 'jog ༈ /rin chen gling pa'i rdzogs chen chig chod kun grol ni mtshan ma'i dbang rdzas la mi ltos kyang mtshon byed tsam du maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad mdzes tshon 'ja' ris sna lngas bskor ba'i dbus su khri'u'i steng rin po che'i bum pa lnga tshan lnga'i bcud dang mgul chings mthing ga

/kha rgyan shing lo me tog 'bras bu dang bcas pa gzug /mdun du me long g.ya' med pa'i steng shel sgong zur brgyad dang rma bya'i sgro mdongs bzhag ༈ /mnga' ris grub chen gyi yig drug gsol 'debs kyi rig gtad la maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab ma drug pa'i steng khri'ur 'gro 'dul sku brnyan/ 'dab drug la ma ṇi 'bru drug gi tsaka li/ g.yas su bum pa chings dkar/ g.yon du shel phreng dang pad dkar tsaka li bkod/ ༈ /'gro 'dul las 'phro gling pa'i thugs chen don gsal sgron me la dbang gi rnams grangs bdun las/ dang po khrus dbang la/ stegs bu'i dbus su rnam bum mgul chings dkar po dang las bum dmar po can/ nyer lnga'i bcud ldan kha rgyan gyis spras pa bzhag /gnyis pa bgegs sbyong sta gon dbang la/ dkyil 'khor gzhung gsal gyi dbus dang phyogs bzhir dpal gtor lnga la bud+dha sogs rta mgrin rigs lnga'i tsaka li btsugs pa dang*/ shar du dbang bum/ byang du khrus bum bkod/ phyi mchod bskor bsham/ dpung skud tshon sna lnga bsgrim mam gang 'byor/ ku sha'i chun po/ lcags snod du me thab gru gsum mthing nag me ris bskor ba'i steng du skyer pa sogs drag shing gru gsum du brtsegs pa/ mchod rdzas sman raka gtor ma/ me rdzas dug khrag mu zi gu gul nag po rta sbang phye rnams mar nag gam a rag gis ngar btags pa dang*/ spyi mthun nyer mkho'i yo byad du bya/ gsum pa bum dbang la/ dkyil 'khor gzhung gsal dbus khri'u'i steng rnam rgyal bum pa so lnga'i bcud ldan mgul chings can gyi khar 'od dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs rigs lnga'i tsaka li bkod/ shar du rdor dril/ lhor dbang gtor/ nub tu thod khrag /byang du sman thod/ pad 'dab brgyad la zhal zas brgyad bkod pa la shar du lha dbang sogs thub drug tsaka li g.yas bskor du btsugs/ byang dang byang shar gnyis la mi dgos/ sgo bzhir dpal gtor bzhi la rnam rgyal/

gshin rje/ rta mgrin/ 'khyil ba bzhi'i tsaka li btsugs/ rgyal srid dang rtags brgyad so so ba/ 'di'i rgyal srid la 'khor lo'i tshab tu rgyal po rin chen phyag na gser 'khor bsnams pa dgos/ 'di mtshungs rdor gling sogs gter rnying gzhan la'ang snang bas dkyus 'gres khyad gsod mi rung ba 'dra/ byang du dam chu/ shar du khrus bum bcas bsham/ bzhi pa gsang dbang la/ dkyil 'khor dbus mañdzi'i steng rnam bum du so lnga'i rdzas la yig bdun bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i bcud ldan mgul chings dkar po kha rgyan ldan pa dang*/ oṃ dkar po la yig drug gis bskor ba'i gsung dkyil bkod/ de rgyab 'dab bzhi'i shar nas brtsam hūm̐ sngon po/ trām̐ ser po/ hrīḥdamar po/ āḥljang gu bzhi la re re bzhin yig drug gis bskor ba'i gsung dkyil bzhi bkod/ yig drug kyang oṃ dkar po sogs thub drug so so'i sku mdog ltar bri bar gsungs pa grub na legs/ de rgyab 'dab brgyad la phyogs bzhir bum pa mthing ser dmar ljang gi dar chings can byang sems dkar po dang*/ dkar gsum bcud ldan/ mtshams gzhir thod pa mtshan ldan bzhi chang dang byang sems dmar po mngar gsum sbyar bas bkang ba bzhag /lnga pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang*/ dkyil 'khor gzhung mthun bris pa'i zla gam dkar po la/ pho thod nang 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i dbus dang rtsibs la rigs lnga'i sa bon bris pa'i nang du byang sems dkar po dang dkar gsum byugs la dar dkar gyis bkab pa bzhag /zla gam dmar por mo thod nang pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus dang 'dab lngar yab yum lnga'i sa bon bris pa'i nang du byang sems dmar po dang mngar gsum blugs la dar dmar gyis bkab pa bzhag /de rgyab 'dab bzhi'i shar du rnam bum/ lhor dbu rgyan/ nub tu dbang gtor/ byang du rdor dril dang khrus bum/ gzhan yang dpa' bo dang rig ma'i tsaka li 'du bya/ drug pa tshig dbang rin po che la/

dkyil 'khor dbus dang phyogs bzhir mchod rten dkar mthing ser dmar ljang gu lnga dang me long re re bzhag /bdun pa rig pa'i rtsal dbang la/ dkyil 'khor dbus su spyan ras gzigs kyi sku rin po che las grub pa bzhag /mthar dar kha dog lnga so sor bting ba'i steng du kha dog sna tshogs pa'i snod rnams su chu la tshon gyis kha dog bsgyur ba lta bu'i bcud kyang de mtshungs blugs pa dang*/ shel rdo me long bkod/ ༈ /mchog ldan mgon po'i gnyen po lha lnga la dkyil 'khor ras bris sam tshom bu gcig pa'i steng du bum pa chings nag can/ mdun du lha lnga'i tsaka li dang rta mgo ljang zhur rngog ma dmar ser mar zan la bcos pa/ g.yas su khyung lnga'i ril bu dang thod phreng*/ rgyab tu tshe 'brang ril chang bcas pa dang*/ gnam lcags rdo rje/ g.yon du me long*/ gdab phur stegs la gzug ༈ /tshe g.yang 'gugs pa la/ gter bum/ gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba ser po kha zas bzang rgus bskor ba/ tshe 'brang ril chang*/ phye mar/ mda' dar/ g.yang chang bcas/ ༈ /grol tig zhi khro la dkyil 'khor steng bum pa gsang thod me long sin+dhu ra'i thig le can shel rdo rnams brtsegs nas bkod/ zhi khro'i lha tsaka tshang bar bcas/ ༈ /'chi med mtsho skyes snying tig gsang sgrub mtsho skyes rdo rje la ras bris sam maṇ+ḍal tshom bu gcig pa'i steng rnam bum/ g.yas su gsang thod/ g.yon du me long dwangs pa dang rta phag yab yum gyi tsaka li/ rgyab tu bla gtor rnams bkod/ ༈ /'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig dbang thams cad kyi mjug tu bzhag yod/ ༈ /'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig las/ bla sgrub byin rlabs snying po'i dbang bskur bltas chog tu bkod pa la mtshan nyid ldan pa'i gnas khang gtsang ma rgyan gyis spras pa'i dbus su stegs bu la dkyil 'khor gzhi mthing ga la pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar gtso bo'i sku'am phyag mtshan bris pa'i mtha' bskor 'od lnga'i mu khyud kyis bskor ba/

de'i dbus 'phrul stegs la bum pa mgul chings dkar po so lnga'i bcu ldan gyi steng du kā pa la mtshan ldan chang dang chos sman mngar gsum sbyar bas bkang ba'i khar me long sin+dhū ra brdal ba'i lte bar a/ de rgyab sngags 'khor bris pas bkab/ de steng 'ja' shel bcas brtsegs mar bkod/ mdun du rig 'dzin gsum dang*/ kun bzang dang che mchog gi tsakli/ khri gdugs rdor dril sogs slob dpon chas/ g.yas su sman gyi pho brang*/ g.yon du tshe 'brang*/ tshe chang*/ tshe ril/ rgyab tu tshe mda' bcas/ sman rag gtor gsum phyi mchod sogs lag len ltar bsham/ las bum/ mig dar/ me tog sngon gtor/ tshogs kyi yo byad/ srung ma'i gtor 'bul sogs las byang la dgos pa rnams kyang tshogs par bya'o/ ༈ /grub thob thugs tig la/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu gcig pa'i steng rnam bum/ mdun sogs su grub chen thang rgyal sku'am tsaka li/ ā li kā li'i sngags byang*/ gsang thod/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang rig tsaka /shel rdo 'ja' ris/ kha ṭ+wām̐ cang te'u thod pa/ rgyab phyogs bla gtor rgyan ldan bkod/ tshe dbang la/ bum pa/ thod chang*/ tshe ril/ shel rdo me long bcas phal cher snga mas 'thus par byas kyang chog ༈ /grub thob thugs thig gi sgrubs thabs skor lnga la/ dkyil 'khor ras bris sam maṇ+ḍal la tshom bu lha grangs bkod pa 'og ma rnams la'ang 'gre/ bla ma zhi ba la dkyil 'khor dbus rkang gsum steng rnam bum bcud ldan mgul chings dkar po kha rgyan bcas/ kha rgyan gseb bam mdun du gu ru za hor ma'i sku tsaka /g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab rnams su dbu rgyan/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ rgyud kyi glegs bam/ me long*/ chos gos rnam gsum/ rin chen rus rgyan phyogs bsdus kyi tsaka li/ gsang thod bdud rtsi/ rig tsaka /rgyab phyogs su bla ma'i gtor chen/ slob mar bkye rgyu'i dngos grub rdzas/ mdun du tshe 'brang*/ tshe ril/ tshe chang*/ rdzas rtags dang rgyal srid tsaka li/

stegs zur pa lta bur gar bder sgo 'byed khrus bum/ mar me/ chu bum/ rdo rje/ lhung bzed chos gos glegs bam phyogs bsdus/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis gzugs ris rnams bkod/ til sbyong sogs nyer mkho rnams kyang bsdogs/ ༈ /gur drag la dkyil 'khor dbus su bum pa chings dmar/ gur drag gtso bo'i sku/ sngags byang*/ phyag mtshan rdo rje'am me long*/ rgyab ngos su dpal gtor dar gdugs can/ las phur rnams bkod/ lcags hom/ ling ga /bsgral chas rnams 'du bya/ ༈ /thugs rje chen po la dkyil 'khor dbus bum pa chings dkar/ 'gro 'dul phyag bzhi pa yum can sku tsaka /shel phreng sngags byang*/ phyag mtshan phreng ba pad dkar/ mdun ngos myong grol ril bum rgyab tu zhi gtor dar gdugs kyis spras pa bkod/ ༈ /rta mgrin la/ dkyil 'khor dbus rnam bum bcud ldan chings dmar can/ rta mgrin gtso bo'i sku/ sngags byang dang rak+sha'i phreng ba/ phyag mtshan rdo rje kha ṭ+wām̐ ral gri sdigs mdzub mdung thung rgyu zhags phyogs gcig bris pa/ rgyab tu dpal gtor rta zhal can/ gdab phur/ lcags hom ling ga /bsgral chas/ me hom/ gtor zor sogs 'du bya/ ༈ /phag mo la/ dkyil 'khor dbus khri'u la thod pa mtshan ldan bdud rtsis bkang ba'i khar sin+dhu ra'i me long la chos 'byung bam̐ yig sngags byang gis bskor bas bcad la/ dar dmar gyis bkab pa'i steng shel rdo bzhag /gtso mo'i sku/ sngags byang thod phur/ me long*/ g.yas su bhan+dha kha sbyor bdud rtsi ril bus bkang ba chas ldan/ g.yon du sman gtor rak+ta mar me rnams snod gcig tu bzhag pa rnams bkod/ ༈ /rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig thun mong smin byed ye shes thig le la/ sta gon tshom bu/ rdzas bzhi/ dngos gzhi la ras bris steng du mañdzi'i khar bum pa/ shar du dbu rgyan/ lhor rdo rje/ nub dril bu/ byang du rdo dril lhan cig pa/ dbus su kun bzang*/ bka' bab rig 'dzin brgyad/

bka' brgyad dpal dgu/ thod phreng sde lnga/ gu ru mtshan brgyad bcas kyi lha tsaka lha dbang ye shes char 'bebs ltar/ mtshams rnams su gsang dbang thod pa chang dang a mṛ ta mngar gsum sbyar bas bkang ba/ rig tsaka /me long*/ shel rdo/ sgrub pod/ dung dkar/ dril bu/ 'khor lo/ seng khri sogs slob ma mnga' gsol chas/ dbang gtor ri rab rin chen zur brgyad nyi zla'i steng bla gtor rgyan spros tsaka gdugs can bcas/ ༈ /rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying thig gi byin rlabs brda yi dbang bzhi la/ rtsa dbang dang sbrel skabs bshams bkod dang dbang sgrub logs su mi dgos/ ༈ /gtor dbang byin rlabs dpal ster rtsa dbang dang sbrel skabs bshams bkod dang dbang sgrub logs su mi dgos/ ༈ /tshe sgrub 'chi med drwa ba'i dbang bzhi ye shes snying po la/ dkyil 'khor ras bris kyi steng mañdzi'i khar bum pa bcud ldan mdun du lha tsaka yongs rdzogs/ de'i g.yas g.yon du tshe ril tshe chang*/ gsang thod/ rig tsaka me long*/ shel rdo/ dbang gtor/ bkra shis rdzas rtags rin chen bdun gyi tsakli/ mda' dar bcas/ ༈ /bud+dha thod phreng rtsal gyi sgos sgrub kyi dbang la/ ras bris steng 'phrul stegs la 'og tu rnam rgyal bum pa bcud ldan/ steng du bhan+dha kha sbyor nang tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i a mṛ tas bkang ba dar sna lngas g.yogs shing dbu rgyan dang*/ g.yas g.yon du rdor dril bcings pa'i sman gyi pho brang dang*/ sngags phreng me long*/ dpal gyi gtor ma gdugs mthing bcas/ ༈ /rdo rje thod phreng rtsal gyi dbang la/ dkyil 'khor dbus su mañdzi la zhi byed bdud rtsi'i bum pa mgul chings dkar po can/ nang bcud so lnga'i rdzas kyis gtams pa/ de'i mdun du rnam rgyal bum pa/ dpal gtor dar gdugs dkar po/ sngags phreng me long bcas/ ༈ /rat+na thod phreng rtsal gyi dbang la/ ras bris steng mañdzi la rnam bum dang*/ ban+dha gser mdog rgyas pa'i las la 'os pa 'bru sman dkar mngar gyi zas dang bdud rtsi chos sman gyis bkang ba la sngags byang gser gyis bris pa'i gzungs bsgril kyang bzhag

/dpal gtor dar gdugs ser po/ mda' dar/ sngags phreng*/ me long bcas/ ༈ /pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi dbang la/ ras bris steng mañdzi la bum pa/ dpal gtor dar gdugs dmar po/ sngags phreng*/ me long*/ dgang gzar blug bcas/ ༈ /karma thod phreng rtsal la ras bris bkram pa'i steng zor gtor thog mdel gyi dbyibs can/ gtso bos sum cha las dma' ba'i 'khor rang 'dra bzhi/ de las sum cha khri ba'i de rgyab bzhi bcas phyogs bzhir bkod/ bar rnams mtheb kyu khrag skong gis ltems shing thams cad kha dog nag po 'ba' zhig bya/ spro na gtso bo srin zhal phyungs legs dar gdugs mthing ga la gzhung mthun sku tsag dang nang khrol/ ba su tas brgyan/ mtshe rtsang sogs btsugs/ byang shar nas g.yas bskor gyis drag po'i nyer spyod mchod pas bskor/ g.yas g.yon du sman raka thun gtor/ gtor chung*/ rnam bum/ dpal gtor dar gdugs nag po/ mda' dar/ sngags phreng*/ me long*/ lcags hom du liṅga/ phur bu/ gser skyems kyi snod bcas/ ༈ /nang sgrub bla ma longs sku thugs rje chen po pad+ma drwa ba'i dbang la/ dkyil 'khor steng mañdzi la rnam rgyal bum pa/ lha tsaka yongs rdzogs/ me long*/ gsang thod/ rig tsaka shel rdo/ sgrub skor gyi glegs bam/ dbang gtor bcas/ ༈ /gsang sgrub bla ma chos sku 'od dpag med kyi sgrub thabs 'od gsal drwa ba'i smin byedal/ ras bris steng mañdzi'i khar rnam rgyal bum pa/ gsang thod bdud rtsi'i sbag pa'i ma da na/ rig tsaka /shel rdo/ lha tsaka tshang ba/ me long*/ sgrub pod bcas/ ༈ /gsang sgrub bla ma chos sku 'od dpag med kyi sgrub thabs 'od gsal drwa ba'i smin byed la/ ras bris kyi steng mañdzi'i khar rnam rgyal bum pa chas ldan bcud kyis sum gnyis bkang ba/ gsang thod bdud rtsi'i sbag pa'i ma da na/ rig tsaka /shel rdo/ lha tsaka /me long*/ sgrub pod bcas/ ༈ /yang gsang bla ma drag po dmar chen yi dam dgongs 'dus kyi smin byed la/

ras bris kyi steng mañdzi'i khar rnam bum/ gsang dbang gi rdzas/ bdud rtsi bhan+dha/ rig tsaka /shel rdo/ sgrub gzhung gi glegs bu/ lha tsaka /me long bcas/ ༈ /'jam dpal drag po gshin rje dmar po 'chi bdag zil gnon gy-i dbang la/ stegs bur maṇ+ḍal me tog gi tshom bu gcig bkod pa'i steng mañdzi'i steng bum pa bcud ldan/ dur khrod dpal chas kyi tsaka li/ sngags byang*/ thod dbyug dang dung khrag phur pa rnams dngos saṃ tsakli gang 'byor bcas/ ༈ /rta mgrin 'chi med dbang chen 'dus pa'i ye shes sgo 'byed byin rlabs snang ba la/ ras bris bkram pa'i steng bum pa/ sngags byang*/ rdo rje'i kha ṭ+wām̐ ral gri bhan+dha mdung thung zhags pa bcas phyag mtshan phyogs bsdus/ tshe ril/ tshe chang*/ sgrol phur/ shel rdo me long*/ dpal gtor sman rag /bsgral dbang rgyas pa spro na lcags hom du ling ga sogs 'du bya/ ༈ /rnam par 'joms pa'i dbang bskur la/ dkyil 'khor bkram pa'i steng mañdzi'i khar bum pa rdzas ldan dbang khrus sbrag ma byed na bum rdzas nyer lnga'i steng*/ shel/ rdo rje pha lam/ ut+pal sngon po/ shu dag /gi wam̐/ ga bur bcas sbyar shing khrus rdzas blugs/ sngags phreng*/ phyag mtshan rdo rje/ shel dang me long*/ dbang gtor dkar zlum rnams dang*/ khrus blud byed na gtor snod du zan gyi gru bzhi/ zlum po/ zla gam/ gru gsum gyi dbyibs can gyi bshos bu bzhi rgyan ldan dang de'i mdun du/ sku glud ser po/ dkar po/ dmar po/ ljang gu bcas la chang bu ting lo nam rgyang mtha' 'phang 'bru sman dar ras rin chen sogs mthun rdzas kyis gtams pa bcas/ ༈ /yang phur sbrags ma khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i dril sgrub kyi dbang la/ ras bris dbus su mtshan dang ldan pa'i bhan+dha'i nang ro ras kyis dkris pa'i sdong bu dgu pa'i zhun chen gyi mar me byas pa bzhag te mdun du bla ma'i gtor chen bcas la sman raka dang nyer spyod kyis bskor/

phur pa bcas/ ༈ /phur pa 'dus pa'i dril sgrub kyi dbang la/ ras bris bkram pa'i lte bar phur gdan la lcags sam drag po'i shing gi sgrub phur mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dar mthing ga'i cod pan can btsugs/ mdun du bla ma'i gtor chen/ las phur bcas/ ༈ /phur pa 'dus pa'i dril sgrub kyi dbang la/ ras bris steng mañdzi la bum pa rgyan ldan bcud kyi sum gnyis bkang ba/ sku tsaka /sngags byang*/ rdor sems sku tsaka /dur khrod dpal chas/ rdo rje rtse dgu dang rtse lnga/ kha ṭ+wām̐/ me phung*/ phur pa ste phyag mtshan phyogs bsdus kyi tsaka li/ gsang thod/ rig tsaka /gdab phur/ lcags hom du liṅga/ g.yab dar/ me hom/ zor chas phyogs bsdus mnan chas bcas/ ༈ /phag dkar ye shes gsal byed kyi byin rlabs la/ ras bris kyi chos 'byung dkar po bsnol ma dur khrod rdo ra me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i lte bar rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa bam̐ yig gis mtshan pa dang*/ 'dab ma bzhi la thugs srog ha ri ni sa zhes pa dgod/ de'i dbus su mañdzi'i steng bum pa bcud ldan mgul chings dkar pos spras pa bzhag /de steng thod pa mtshan ldan bdud rtsis gtams pa'i khar sin+dhū ra'i me long chos 'byung bam̐ yig sngags phreng gis brgyan pa bcas/ ༈ /rdo rje phag mo bde chen dkar mo'i tshe spel ba'i byin rlabs la/ dkyil 'khor dbus su tshe 'brang thabs shes kyi rdzas tshe ril chang g.yas g.yon du bkod/ mda' dar bcas/ ༈ /bka' srung lcam dral dril sgrub kyi srog dbang la/ drag po'i dkyil 'khor spyi 'gro'am maṇ+ḍal 'bru nag gi tshom bu gsum phreng tshar du bkod pa'i steng gtor ma dpung rong gru gsum/ g.yas su gru gsum g.yas dkyus/ g.yon du dmar gtor rtse bcad bcas la thebs skyu sha khrag shas snas brgyan cing*/ dar gdugs sku tsag gis spras pa dang*/ mgon po ma ning*/ gza'/ sngags srung gi sku tsaka /sngags byang*/ phyag mtshan rnams dang bcas/

༈ /lce btsun snying thig la/ 'od lnga'i dkyil 'khor steng rnam bum a dkar gyis mtshan pa'i khar thod chang*/ de steng shel rdo bzhag ༈ /rjes dran be ro'i thugs tig tshe sgrub zab rgya can la/ maṇ+ḍal dkyil 'khor steng tshe'i 'brang rgyas/ g.yas g.yon du tshe chang*/ tshe ril dkar mngar bza' btung bcas bsham/ ༈ /dag snang tsaṇ+ḍa li la maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dmar po gcig pa'i steng rnam bum/ mdun du tshe 'brang*/ thod chang dang bcud len ril bu g.yas g.yon du bkod/ ༈ /mi tra'i tshe dkar phyi sgrub kyi tshe dbang la me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa'am rgyas par spro na pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su mañdzi'i khar bum pa chas ldan sku tsag gi brgyan pa/ de'i g.yas su tshe ril/ g.yon du tshe chang*/ rgyab tu tshe mda' bcas so/ ༈ /mi tra'i tshe dkar nang sgrub kyi tshe dbang la stegs kyi khar rgyas par spro na gzhal yas spyi ltar gyi dbus su zla gam sgo gcig dmar po lte bar lha mtshan can nam tshom bu lnga bkod pa'i dbus su mañdzi la bum pa sku tsag gis brgyan pa/ mdun du gtor ma/ g.yas su gsang rdzas/ rgyab tu rig tsag /g.yon du me long shel rdo bcas kyi mtha' phyi nang gi mchod pas bskor ba dang*/ ci bde bar tshe ril/ tshe chang*/ tshe mda' bcas so/ ༈ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor ye shes char 'bebs la/ stegs bu'i khar 'bru tshom dmar po'i steng du bhan+dha bdud rtsis bkang ba dang rdo rje sems dpa'i me long bcas/ ༈ /'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos chos rgyal tshangs pa lha'i me tog gi byin rlabs dbang la/ ras bris kyi steng du mañdzi'i khar bum pa thod pa'i bdud rtsi me long sin+dhū ra la chos 'byung mtshan sngags shel rdo bcas/ ༈ /bla sgrub thig le'i rgya can la/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lnga pa'i khar khri'ur bhan+dha dum gsum chos sman 'bru yis bkang ba'i nang rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i srog 'khor bcug pa la dar gur phub/ g.yas su rnam bum/ mdun du bla ma'i sku brnyan/

g.yon du gsang thod rig tsaka ḍā ru kha ṭ+wām̐ rus rgyan rnams kyi tsaka li/ rgyab tu shel rdo dang snying tig chen mo ma bu gang rung gi glegs bam rnams bzhag ༈ /rdo rje sems dpa' la brten pa'i bla ma mchod pa la/ ras bris kyi steng khri'u'i khar sku bum pa/ gsung bdud rtsi/ thugs me long sin+dhū ra/ ye shes rdo rje sems dpa'i me long rnams bzhi brtsegs kyi tshul du bsham/ ༈ /grub thob thugs tig gi khrag 'thung bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang gong du grub zin/ ༈ /sku gsum rigs 'dus zab tig dbang rgyas la/ ras bris steng mañdzi la bum pa bcud ldan mgul chings dmar po can gyi mdun du rdor dril bsnol ma/ g.yas su dbu rgyan/ rgyab tu rdo rje/ g.yon du dril bu dang*/ gzhung mthun lha tsaka rnams dang*/ gsang thod/ rig tsaka /shel rdo/ sngags phreng*/ me long bar do drug gi ngo sprod kyi chas pad+ma'i myu gu'i sku'am/ zhi khro'i lha tsaka gcig bsdus/ mar me/ thig le dmar po hrīḥs mtshan pa/ a yig dkar po/ rdor sems lta bu'i sku/ de'i sngags byang*/ phyag mtshan gyi tsaka li rnams dang*/ tshe 'brang*/ tshe ril chang*/ chos srung gi gtor spungs bcas dang*/ chos 'byung bsnol ma'i steng dpal gtor rgyan spros dar gdugs can dang*/ ༈ /sku gsum rigs 'dus zab tig gtor dbang la dbang rgyas dang sbrel skabs bca' bsham zur du mi dgos/ ༈ /snyan brgyud gshin rje'i thugs tig la/ ras bris sam maṇ+ḍal tshom bu mthing nag gcig bkod pa'i steng thod pa'i snod du bam lag len ltar bcos pa/ g.yas su rnam bum chings sngon can/ mdun du zhi khro gnyis kyi sku tsaka /dur khrod chas/ phyag mtshan drug po g.yas g.yon so sor byas pa/ sngags byang bcas tsaka li drug thod phreng*/ g.yon du mchod rten/ rgyab tu gsang thod rig tsaka shel rdo/ tshe 'brang tshe ril 'gyed bdes bskor ba/ mdun ngos dregs pa'i dmar gtor thebs kyus bskor ba rnams bkod/

༈ /snyan brgyud rta mchog la/ stegs kyi steng du ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor gzhung mthun bkram/ med na maṇ+ḍal la me tog gi tshom bu dmar po gcig bkod pa'i dbus su khri'u'i khar rta zhal ljang gu rngog ma dmar ser nang gzhug snying po'i sngags ldan sku rten tsakli bcas bkod/ g.yas su bum pa so lnga'i bcud ldan kha rgyan 'gul chings dmar po bcas pa/ g.yon du dpal gtor rta zhal can dar gdugs dmar po mdun du gsang thod chang dang mngar gsum sbyar ba dang rig tsaka /dbang phreng dmar po/ rgyab tu snying po lnga dang tshe gal bsdeb pa'i tshe 'brang rta zhal can gyi g.yas g.yon du tshe ril tshe chang rnams dang*/ sman rag gtor gsum/ phyi mchod/ mda' dar/las bum/ bgegs gtor/ tshogs kyi yo byad/ gtor 'bul sogs nyer mkho rnams 'du bya'o/ ༈ /snyan brgyud yang dag zab tig la maṇ+ḍal tshom bu gcig par thod sku/ g.yas bum pa/ g.yon thod chang rig tsaka /mdun du mar me dang sman gyi pho brang*/ shel rdo/ rgyab tu tshe 'brang ril chang bcas bsham/ ༈ /snyan brgyud yang phur sbrags ma'i zab tig gi dbang la/ stegs bu'i dbus su e khrom la sgrub phur tshad ldan dar mthing nag gi cod pan can gzug pa'i steng du 'phrul stegs la bum pa so lnga'i bcud ldan mgul chings mthing ga la rgyan gyis spras pa dang*/ dpal gtor sku tsaka dar gdugs kyis brgyan pa bkod/ g.yas g.yon tu thod pa mtshan ldan chang dang mngar gsum chos sman sbyar bas bkang ba dang*/ rig tsaka /las bum/ tshe 'brang*/ tshe ril/ tshe chang*/ mda' dar rnams ci bder bkram/ bsgral dbang chas las phur/ dbye rdzas bya 'ug sgro/ yungs dkar/ byad thag /dug khrag /sgrol gri/ tho ba/ hom gzar/ lcags hom du liṅga/ gser skyems chas/ gtor zor gru gsum mtshe yungs kyis brgyan pa bcas/ ༈ /snyan brgyud bdud rtsi'i mchog tig gi dbang la/ stegs bu'i steng du ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bkram pa'am ma 'dzom na maṇ+ḍal dbus su gtso bo tshom bu mthing nag 'khor brgyad kyis bskor bar bzhag

/de steng khri'u'i khar thod pa mtshan ldan a mṛ tas bkang ba/ g.yas su sman gyi pho brang*/ g.yon du mar me/ mdun sogs su sku tsaka /sngags byang dang phreng ba/ dur khrod chas brgyad/ dkyil 'khor tsakli/ sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga/ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar rnams ril bu'am phye mar sbyar bas snod so sor bzhags/ btags btsags sbol zhing gzhal ba'i yo byad phab rnams ri mo bris pa sogs gang bder phyogs bsdus/ rgyab tu snying po lnga chang gis sbrus pa'i tshe 'brang nang du bzla bya'i sngags kyi shog dril bcug pa'i g.yas g.yon du tshe ril tshe chang bcas bkod/ sman gtor rak+ta/ phyi mchod rnams spyi ltar/ las bum/ mda' dar/ tshogs dang gtor 'bul sogs phrin las la dgos pa'i rigs rnams tshogs par bya/ ༈ /snyan brgyud phur pa'i gnad tig la/ ras bris sam tshom bu dbus su gtso phur dang rnam bum brtsegs pa'am mdun rgyab tu bzhag /sku tsaka /sngags byang*/ dur khrod dpal chas gcig bsdus/ gsang thod rig tsaka gdab phur tshe 'brang brub khung nya bo rnams spyi ltar bkod/ ༈ /srid pa ma mo'i gnad tig la/ ras bris kyi steng du khri'ur khar gsang bum thod pa mtshan ldan la a mṛ tas bkang ba dar mthing nag gis bkab/ mdun ngos sogs su/ thod sku/ sngags byang dang phreng ba/ shel rdo'am tsit+ta/ bdud rtsi chos sman/ gtor snod du ri rab bang rim bzhi'i steng du dpal bshos/ g.yas g.yon tu sman raka /rgyab ngos su nam mkha' btsugs pa'i mdos gtor rnams dang*/ rgyab mdun gang bder tshe 'brang*/ tshe chang tshe ril bcas/ ༈ /'phags ma'i snying thig gi rtsa dbang la/ sta gon rdzas bzhi/ slob ma mchod pa bsdogs/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor dbus khri'u la/ rnam bum nyer lnga'i bcud ldan mgul chings dkar po kha rgyan gzungs rdor dang bcas pa/ shar du dbu rgyan/ lhor rdo rje/ nub tu dril bu/ byang du rdor dril lhan cig pa/ gtso 'khor lha tsaka bcu gcig

/shel phreng me long*/ gsang thod/ rig tsaka /shel rdo rnams spyi ltar bkod/ rje gnang chas dung*/ dril bu/ sgrub pod/ glegs bam/ gdugs rnams kyang zur du 'jog ༈ /yang zab byin rlabs la/ ras bris dbus su thod par bcud len ril bu/ g.yas su rnam bum/ g.yon du tshe 'brang*/ ༈ thun mong rjes gnang la dkyil 'khor dbus su bum pa/ g.yas su thod chang*/ g.yon du tshe 'brang*/ mdun du tshe ril rnams bzhag pa bcas so/
